services.title: OpenStreetMap
services.description: The standard map of OpenStreetMap, the free map of the world made by its contributors. Data under the Open Database Licence. The tile servers are run by volunteers on donated resources: browse, but don't download areas in bulk.

services.title: OpenTopoMap
services.description: A topographic map with contour lines and hill shading, drawn from OpenStreetMap and SRTM elevation data. CC BY-SA.
services.attribution: Map data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, SRTM | Map style: © OpenTopoMap (CC-BY-SA)

services.title: USGS The National Map: imagery
services.description: Aerial and satellite imagery of the United States from the US Geological Survey, with Blue Marble for the rest of the world. Public domain.

services.title: NASA GIBS: Blue Marble with bathymetry
services.description: NASA's Blue Marble of the whole Earth, with shaded relief on land and the depths of the sea, from the Global Imagery Browse Services. Nothing within 5° of the poles.

services.title: EMODnet Bathymetry
services.description: Depths of the European seas and the oceans from the European Marine Observation and Data Network, as a coloured base map. CC BY 4.0. Not for navigation.

services.title: Google Maps
services.description: Google's road map of the world: roads, places and borders. The address is Google's own tile server, not a published API: Google's terms allow its maps only through Google's own services, so check them before use; the address may stop working at any time. Browse only: no offline regions.

services.title: Google Maps - Satellite
services.description: Google's satellite and aerial imagery of the world, without labels. The address is Google's own tile server, not a published API: Google's terms allow its maps only through Google's own services, so check them before use; the address may stop working at any time. Browse only: no offline regions.

services.title: Google Maps - Hybrid
services.description: Google's satellite and aerial imagery with roads, places and borders over it. The address is Google's own tile server, not a published API: Google's terms allow its maps only through Google's own services, so check them before use; the address may stop working at any time. Browse only: no offline regions.

services.title: ESRI - World Imagery
services.description: Esri's satellite and aerial imagery of the world: 15 m imagery everywhere, and 1 m or better in many places, down to 0.3 m or finer in some cities. No labels. Esri's terms of use apply (the link below); browse only: no offline regions.
services.attribution: Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community

services.title: ESRI - World Physical Map
services.description: Natural Earth's physical map of the world, its land cover and relief, from the US National Park Service, at about 1.2 km per pixel. Esri's terms of use apply (the link below); browse only: no offline regions.

services.title: ESRI - World Shaded Relief
services.description: The shape of the land as grey shaded relief, from SRTM and other elevation data, made to lie under other maps. Esri's terms of use apply (the link below); browse only: no offline regions.

services.title: ESRI - World Street Map
services.description: Esri's street map of the world: highways everywhere, and streets in most countries. Esri's terms of use apply (the link below); browse only: no offline regions.
services.attribution: Sources: Esri, HERE, Garmin, USGS, Intermap, INCREMENT P, NRCan, Esri Japan, METI, Esri China (Hong Kong), Esri Korea, Esri (Thailand), NGCC, © OpenStreetMap contributors, and the GIS User Community

services.title: ESRI - World Terrain Base
services.description: A plain background of shaded relief, the sea floor and coastal waters, made to lie under other data. Esri's terms of use apply (the link below); browse only: no offline regions.

services.title: ESRI - World Topo Map
services.description: Esri's topographic map of the world: boundaries, places, water, parks, roads, railways and airports over land cover and shaded relief. Esri's terms of use apply (the link below); browse only: no offline regions.
services.attribution: Sources: Esri, HERE, Garmin, Intermap, increment P Corp., GEBCO, USGS, FAO, NPS, NRCAN, GeoBase, IGN, Kadaster NL, Ordnance Survey, Esri Japan, METI, Esri China (Hong Kong), © OpenStreetMap contributors, and the GIS User Community
